title: Universal exact finite subset-action moduli by maximal integer minors
status: Complete traditional mathematical proof draft, exact integer program and GitHub-hosted CI; initial compiled Lean lemma only; no external peer review or priority certification.
key_results: Every finite n>=1, 0<=k<=n: exact optimal C_{n,k} as a finite maximum of integer maximal-minor absolute-value ratios, plus exact exceptional cases.
For m=min(k,n-k)>=1 the orbital constraint matrix has full row rank m+1; an explicit subdeterminant equals (-1)^m product_{r=0}^{m-1} binom(n-2r,m-r).
Every positive optimum is attained by an exact central signed perturbation involving at most m+2 conjugacy classes; bound m+2 sharp at (n,k)=(11,4).
All finite permutation group actions admit an analogous rational maximal-minor exact formula using their conjugacy classes and orbitals.
Preferred rank determinant proof uses finite integer-polynomial trace recurrences with no algebraic-root or formal-series derivation.
sparse_sharp_case: (11,4), exact 6 tight types and 5x6 cofactor vector with no zero entries
critical_limitations: The formula remains a finite maximum over potentially exponentially many integer determinant candidates as m grows; a bounded-branch elementary piecewise-rational formula is not proved.
Polynomial runtime is asserted only for fixed m as n grows, not polynomial in logarithmic input size or variable m.
No full Lean kernel verification, external human referee report or systematic novelty/priority certification.
